disposition_reason: Original ICP-OES measurements of 11 elements in bread from Susangerd bakeries (pooled summary, Table 4), alongside a urinary-metal case-control analysis.

study.design: Bread sampling within a cardiovascular case-control study (Hoveyzeh cohort) with risk assessment
study.origin: Flour from a single factory supplying the bakeries
study.method: Air-dried, oven-dried at 60 °C, ground, dry-ashed at 450 °C, extracted with 4 M HNO3 at 95 °C; ICP-OES
lod: Instrument LODs listed for urine work (µg/L): V 1, Ni 2, Fe 2, Zn 1, Sr 0, Al 1, As 0, Cd 1, Sb 0, Hg 2, Pb 1; LOQs as printed; no food-specific LODs
study.qa: Calibration standards 10-1000 ppb; no certified reference material or recovery reported for bread

unresolved: Number of bread samples is unclear ('Three samples of Rice bread, Tafton bread, and Baguette bread'); Table 4 pools all bread types and gives no n.
Per-bread-type concentrations are not printed; Table 5 gives only hazard quotients, which were not back-calculated.
Collection dates for bread are not reported.
Cr mean (0.31) exceeds Cr maximum (0.148) in Table 4.
Urine results (Table 3) are biological and not extracted.

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Limits quoted in Table 4 as acceptable (WHO, per authors): As 0.1, Cd 0.2, Cr 0.02, Ni 1.63, Pb 0.3, Zn 27.4 mg/kg
Hazard quotients and hazard index by bread type (rice, Tafton, baguette) for children and adults; all HI < 1
